title: 金屬冷噴塗修復工程
summary: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜薄膜厚度：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Film thickness: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」。畫出「基材 → 表面處理 → 薄層 → 界面 → 區域量測」並圈出與「薄膜厚度」有關的介面。將 cycles*growth 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：飽和且穩定成長的理想層數模型將循環數乘每循環成長。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion. Draw Substrate → Surface process → Surface layer → Interface → Spatial metrology and mark the interfaces relevant to Film thickness. Place every variable of cycles*growth on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: An ideal stable saturated-growth model multiplies cycles by growth per cycle. Identify what it cannot establish: Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.observation: 對照「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.

steps.title: 單元1｜薄膜厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Film thickness: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」的「薄膜厚度」採以下合成教學值：cycles=100 cycle；growth=0.1 nm/cycle。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 cycles*growth；獨立基準為 10 nm。把 cycles 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 11 nm。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion, use synthetic inputs for Film thickness: cycles=100 cycle；growth=0.1 nm/cycle. Check dimensions before evaluating cycles*growth; the independent benchmark is 10 nm. Increase cycles by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 11 nm. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: cycles增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 1 nm。初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 1 nm. Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.check: 原值重算與 10 nm 相符；10%案例與 11 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 10 nm at baseline and 11 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（nm）？
quiz.explanation: 按 cycles*growth 逐項代入，結果為 10；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into cycles*growth gives 10; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜薄膜厚度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Film thickness: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」設計「薄膜厚度」的獨立驗證：以至少三個循環數量厚度，檢查斜率和非零截距。 把厚度分布、局部缺陷與附著證據分欄，不能以平均膜厚代替界面品質。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion, independently verify Film thickness: Measure thickness at three cycle counts and inspect slope and nonzero intercept. Separate thickness maps, local defects and adhesion; average thickness is not interface quality. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：以至少三個循環數量厚度，檢查斜率和非零截距。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Measure thickness at three cycle counts and inspect slope and nonzero intercept.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜薄膜厚度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Film thickness: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」。以本單元「薄膜厚度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以至少三個循環數量厚度，檢查斜率和非零截距。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates. For Film thickness, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Measure thickness at three cycle counts and inspect slope and nonzero intercept. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」不是單靠 10 nm 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 10 nm alone cannot exclude Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；初始成核延遲、粗糙度與非飽和表面使線性關係失效。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Nucleation delay, roughness and unsaturated surfaces break linearity.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 1, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion and retaining failed cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與模型
knowledge.text: 密度是質量除以明確定義的體積；外形體積會包含孔隙。
knowledge.textEn: Density divides mass by a defined volume; external volume includes pores.

knowledge.title: 案例與驗證界限
knowledge.text: 冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著。鬆裝、壓實及真密度不同，不能互換。 前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
knowledge.textEn: Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion. Loose-packed, compacted and true density are not interchangeable. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.

steps.title: 單元2｜表觀密度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Bulk density: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」設計「表觀密度」的獨立驗證：明列體積量測法、含水狀態及重複裝填的散布。 把厚度分布、局部缺陷與附著證據分欄，不能以平均膜厚代替界面品質。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion, independently verify Bulk density: State the volume method, moisture condition and scatter across repeated packing. Separate thickness maps, local defects and adhesion; average thickness is not interface quality. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；鬆裝、壓實及真密度不同，不能互換。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Loose-packed, compacted and true density are not interchangeable.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「鬆裝、壓實及真密度不同，不能互換。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Loose-packed, compacted and true density are not interchangeable.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：明列體積量測法、含水狀態及重複裝填的散布。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: State the volume method, moisture condition and scatter across repeated packing.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「鬆裝、壓實及真密度不同，不能互換。」。

steps.title: 單元2｜表觀密度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Bulk density: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」。以本單元「表觀密度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「明列體積量測法、含水狀態及重複裝填的散布。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates. For Bulk density, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use State the volume method, moisture condition and scatter across repeated packing. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「厚度達標卻界面仍剝離」不是單靠 2000 kg/m³ 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 2000 kg/m³ alone cannot exclude Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 厚度達標卻界面仍剝離；鬆裝、壓實及真密度不同，不能互換。
steps.failureEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates; Loose-packed, compacted and true density are not interchangeable.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「冷噴塗沉積厚度與基材界面附著」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Cold-spray deposit thickness and substrate adhesion and retaining failed cases.

quiz.question: 哪個推論應在本課拒絕？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference should this case reject?

厚度達標卻界面仍剝離
以獨立量測檢核「表觀密度」。
optionsEn: Meeting thickness while the interface delaminates
Check Bulk density with independent measurements.
